field_classification.dmin_km: source minimum angular distance multiplied by fixed111.195km/degree
field_classification.target: source-reported depth uncertainty, not independent true depth error

independent_units: Transitive clusters within100km great-circle chord and7days; complete cluster hashfolds. Distant events may still share network/systematic velocity model errors.
limitations: This snapshot summarizes location-solver products; task remains a diagnostic for reported uncertainty, not independent discovery or earthquake forecasting
Uncertainty confidenceLevel and depthType are absent from all source origins
Common networks and velocity-model systematics can cross cluster partitions
GeoJSON presents20 zero distances where QuakeML omits minimumDistance; no replacement or cohort change is made
The endpoint includes the endtime boundary according to official documentation; no source event lies exactly on the August1 boundary

partition_provenance.development: Unchanged compact-v2 SHA256([compact-v2,case,opaque clusterID]); first max(2,n_eligible_development_clusters//5) assigned dev
partition_provenance.test: First max(1,n_clusters//5) by SHA256(principia100-batch7:quake:<clusterID>) first64bits, before eligibility

policy.clustering: All source events before eligibility; 100km Euclidean chord on6371km sphere and7days per edge; connected components may span longer distances/times
policy.cross_format: Exact event identity and comparable finite values; retain missingness differences; never impute QuakeML from GeoJSON
policy.eligibility: Original finite six inputs and reported uncertainty, positive target/RMS/phase/station counts, nonnegative station distance, gap0..360; retain excluded-event inventory without imputation
policy.lineage: event publicID, source event index and origin publicID; common field paths and full graph membership retained
policy.origin: Exactly one per event, explicitly matching preferredOriginID; event query identity and catalog attributes must agree

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Historical QuakeML fields, eligibility and full-catalog transitive components independently reimplemented with source-schema, preferred-origin, cross-format, domain and work-limit guards; no old runtime, fitted rule or evaluator copied
